title: Stylized Roaring Tiger in Dynamic Circle Frame
description: The image features a stylized depiction of a roaring tiger, rendered in a modern, graphic art style. The tiger is centered within a white circular frame, which contrasts sharply with the two-toned background of teal and navy blue. The tiger's fur is illustrated with bold, geometric patterns, using a vibrant palette of orange, black, and white, with accents of yellow and red to highlight the intensity of its gaze and the ferocity of its roar. The composition is balanced, with the tiger's body facing forward and its head turned slightly to the right, creating a sense of movement and power. The artwork is designed to be eye-catching and impactful, suitable for merchandise such as t-shirts and other apparel.
